purpose: Handoff inventory for the D6 and D8 folders under data/. It records file facts and embedded metadata. Processing provenance not supplied by the Atishay is explicitly left unverified.

coordinateConventions.warning: Mars projections and coordinates are not Earth WGS 84. Do not assume similarly named app products share the same origin or transform.

datasets.title: THEMIS-derived Thermal Inertia of Jezero Crater, Mars
datasets.citation: Edwards, C. S., & Buz, J. (2021). THEMIS-derived Thermal Inertia of Jezero Crater, Mars. Zenodo. Northern Arizona University.
datasets.measurement: Derived thermal inertia, J m-2 K-1 s-1/2; not surface temperature.

sourceGrid.crs: Mars Simple Cylindrical / equirectangular; central meridian 0°, standard parallel 0°, sphere radius 3,396,190 m.

processingAsDocumentedInMetadata: Mask source zero/null values as NoData.
Reproject to the Mars Transverse Mercator projection used by USGS SIM 3464.
Clip the cleaned Mars TM product to the USGS SIM 3464 MapBoundary.
Resample at 100 m using bilinear interpolation; this does not add detail.
A local app-oriented equirectangular copy is also included.

cleanedMarsTM.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, Transverse Mercator, central meridian 77.5°E, scale factor 1, false easting/northing 0, metres.

appEqc.crs: Project-local Mars equirectangular, central meridian 77.5°E, standard parallel 18.4°, sphere radius 3,396,190 m.
appEqc.validMaskCheck: Counted from the GeoTIFF band using its declared NoData value 0.
appEqc.note: Its tagged grid size and affine transform match the D8 app-EQC categorical raster; confirm pixel alignment before production use.

provenanceStatus.sourceFilesPresent: A source-grid TIFF is present, but the exact original Zenodo archive member name and download checksum were not supplied.
provenanceStatus.processingScript: Not supplied; steps above are transcribed from embedded metadata, not independently reproduced.
provenanceStatus.temporalValidity: Source metadata identifies the derived product and publication year but not a time-specific surface-temperature observation; this layer is a spatial thermal-inertia property.

limitations: Only 55.0% of the cleaned Mars TM output grid is valid; NoData must remain visible.
Not spatially aligned to the app HiRISE grid by declaration.

datasets.title: Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars
datasets.citation: Sun, V., & Stack, K. (2020). Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars. U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map 3464.
datasets.sourceDatabase: USGS SIM 3464; matching source archive is data/raw/JezeroLandmarks/sim3464_database.zip.

marsTransverseMercator.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, Transverse Mercator, central meridian 77.5°E, scale factor 1, false easting/northing 0, metres.

appEqc.crs: Project-local Mars equirectangular, central meridian 77.5°E, standard parallel 18.4°, sphere radius 3,396,190 m.
appEqc.note: The CRS is recorded in the GeoPackage, but its names are generic/unknown. It uses the same declared local projection parameters as D6 app-EQC. Validate feature and raster alignment; separately transform and validate CTX or HiRISE before overlay.

categoricalRasters.valueMeaning: unit_id lookup key, not science score.

datasets.lookup: data/MARSX_D8_GEOLOGY_CLEANED/geologic_unit_lookup.json; IDs map to USGS GeoUnits_v1 codes/names/symbols; value 0 reserved for NoData.
datasets.scienceWeightTemplate: data/MARSX_D8_GEOLOGY_CLEANED/science_weight_template.csv; weights are blank and must not be used by routing until scientifically reviewed.

provenanceStatus.processingScript: Not supplied. Reprojection, any geometry repair, rasterization, and output generation method need teammate confirmation.
provenanceStatus.geojsonCrs: Files are named mars_lonlat but contain no explicit CRS member or Mars coordinate metadata; do not feed into an Earth-oriented GeoJSON renderer without an explicit verified transform.

limitations: SIM 3464 is a regional geology map, not an astronaut-scale obstacle survey.
The app_eqc layers are not the same CRS/origin as the crater-wide CTX DEM; verify alignment.
GeoJSON files are large; package/install as regional data rather than APK assets.
